title: Who Is Jesus?
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: You didn't lose your faith. You built a Jesus who takes orders. A genie for your wishes. A therapist to hype you up. A plushie who never says no. Then He asks for more, and you put Him on the shelf. Week 4 of the ABC series. Pastor Antwan opens The Apostles Creed on the one question that decides everything. Who do you say Jesus is?
quotes: A real king doesn't wait for orders. A real king gives orders.
We love Jesus for saving us, but we don't love him enough to rule us.
Facts are like a GPS. It routes you to reality even if you hate the destination.
